sloka: तत: शिरसि कृत्वा तु पादुके भरतस्तदा ।आरुरोह रथं हृष्ट: शत्रुघ्नेन समन्वित: ॥ २.११३.१॥
transliteration: tata: śirasi kṛtvā tu pāduke bharatastadā ।āruroha rathaṁ hṛṣṭa: śatrughnena samanvita: ॥ 2.113.1॥

translations.english: Then Bharata accompanied by Satrughna, placing the sandals on his head in delight, boarded the chariot.
